nodes.description: uint32 thisChainId: chain id of the current chain, used to branch lock/burn vs release/mint behaviour
address treasury: recipient of cross chain fees, mutable through propose/accept treasury flow
address pendingTreasury: candidate treasury set by current treasury and accepted by the candidate
Supervisor contract used to validate validator signatures for cross chain completions
IXYToken xyToken: the XY token that is locked, burned, minted or transferred by this contract
uint256 maxCrossChainAmount: upper bound for a single cross chain request amount
uint256 numCrossChainRequests: monotonically increasing counter used as cross chain request id
mapping(uint32 => mapping(uint256 => bool)) completedCrossChainRequest: replay protection for relayed requests
initialize(...): initializer setting chain id, treasury, supervisor, xyToken, max amount and access control roles
_lockXYToken(address,uint256): pulls XY token from sender and burns it when this chain is not ETH chain
_releaseXYToken(address,uint256,uint256): transfers from the contract on ETH chain, otherwise mints, plus fee to treasury
proposeNewTreasury(address): only current treasury can nominate a pending treasury
acceptNewTreasury(): pending treasury accepts ownership of the treasury address
_authorizeUpgrade(address): UUPS authorization hook restricted to ROLE_OWNER
rescue(IERC20[]): owner-only sweep of accidentally sent tokens, XY token excluded
pause(): manager-only emergency stop
unpause(): manager-only resumption of operations
setMaxCrossChainAmount(uint256): manager-only update of the cross chain amount cap
completeCrossChainRequest(...): staff-only relay completion validating supervisor signatures before releasing tokens
requestCrossChain(uint32,address,uint256): user entry point that locks XY token and emits a cross chain request
msg.sender: external caller, used for treasury checks, role checks, token source and rescue recipient
xyToken.safeTransferFrom(sender, address(this), amount): external ERC20 call in _lockXYToken
xyToken.burn(amount): external burn call executed when thisChainId != ETH_CHAIN_ID
xyToken.safeTransfer(receiver/treasury, amount): external ERC20 outbound call in _releaseXYToken
xyToken.mint(receiver/treasury, amount): external mint call in _releaseXYToken on non-ETH chains
supervisor.checkSignatures(sigIdHash, signatures): external call to the Supervisor contract for validator threshold validation
token.safeTransfer(msg.sender, balance): external ERC20 transfer out of arbitrary user supplied token in rescue
delegatecall to the new implementation inside _upgradeToAndCallSecure reached via upgradeTo/upgradeToAndCall
sender parameter of _lockXYToken, source address of the token transfer
amount parameter of _lockXYToken, number of tokens pulled and possibly burned
receiver parameter of _releaseXYToken, destination of the released tokens
amount parameter of _releaseXYToken, tokens transferred or minted to the receiver
fee parameter of _releaseXYToken, tokens transferred or minted to the treasury
newTreasury parameter of proposeNewTreasury, stored into pendingTreasury
newMaxCrossChainAmount parameter of setMaxCrossChainAmount, written into maxCrossChainAmount
requestId parameter of completeCrossChainRequest, source chain request identifier
sourceChainId parameter of completeCrossChainRequest, key for the completed request mapping
receiver parameter of completeCrossChainRequest, final token recipient
amount parameter of completeCrossChainRequest, gross amount signed by validators
fee parameter of completeCrossChainRequest, deducted from the gross amount
signatures parameter of completeCrossChainRequest, validator signature array forwarded to the Supervisor
sigId local: keccak256 digest of the cross chain request fields
sigIdHash local: EIP-191 signed message hash of sigId sent to checkSignatures
amountSubFee local: amount minus fee, passed as the released amount
destChainId parameter of requestCrossChain, destination chain of the transfer
receiver parameter of requestCrossChain, recipient on the destination chain
amount parameter of requestCrossChain, tokens locked from msg.sender
id local of requestCrossChain, value of numCrossChainRequests before increment
tokens parameter of rescue, array of ERC20 addresses to sweep
token local of rescue, current ERC20 being swept
_tokenBalance local of rescue, balance of the contract in the swept token
chainId parameter of initialize, assigned to thisChainId
_treasury parameter of initialize, assigned to treasury
_supervisor parameter of initialize, contract-checked and assigned to supervisor
owner parameter of initialize, granted ROLE_OWNER
manager parameter of initialize, granted ROLE_MANAGER
staff parameter of initialize, granted ROLE_STAFF
_xyToken parameter of initialize, contract-checked and assigned to xyToken
_maxCrossChainAmount parameter of initialize, assigned to maxCrossChainAmount
